limitations: L4 covers deterministic synthetic offline acceptance only; no live-source, biological or clinical validation.
Existing gene and trait search adapters may lack variant identity and association details; missing evidence remains unavailable.

The validator checks declared structured claim limits, conservative English clinical wording, an explicit quote-only clinical assertion form and dependency groups, not every semantic overclaim or undisclosed cohort overlap.
Raw transport, normalization against a reference genome, source-native field extraction, and independent review are not implemented by this pack.
